name: firebase-rules-denied
input: Use Git for this Board: a client reads its own profile, but Firebase Rules reject it. Restrict reads to the signed-in user's document, then retest successfully.
expected: compose Before and After behavior on one canvas
use separate directional edges for request and error/response
save a complete local bundle, QA it, and commit only related Board files without pushing
open the localhost Board

name: api-timeout-retry
input: Local only: a web app API call times out; after adding queue retry, a worker writes to the database and reports success.
expected: translate technical evidence into user-readable Before/After behavior
show all edges and labels before playback
write a durable local-only bundle instead of relying on localStorage
open the localhost Board

name: logo-fallback
input: Local only: visualize a niche webhook service's validation failure and fix; the Logo MCP cannot find it.
expected: show Before/After behavior and the cause
search official brand sources and trusted registries, then use the webhook categoryIcon if no reliable logo exists
store reliable assets in the local bundle and open the localhost Board

name: git-choice-gate
input: Turn this login failure into a local behavior Board.
expected: ask only whether to use Git versioning, local-only storage, or cancel on the first turn
explain that both modes preserve complete local data and never push automatically
do not create Board files or run other tools before the user chooses

name: version-compare-restore
input: Local only: list this Board's versions, compare with the previous version at the behavior level, then restore it after confirmation.
expected: distinguish Board revisions from the Before/After flows inside the story
show Added, Removed, Changed, and Moved semantic changes instead of a JSON line diff
require confirmation, validate the source hash, and create an automatic pre-restore backup
reload the complete canvas session after restore

name: traditional-chinese-screen-flow
input: 只存本機：幫我擷取本地 Web App 的登入與 Dashboard 畫面，顯示這次修改前後的操作 flow。
expected: 把截圖存進本地 assets/screens 並使用不可覆寫的新檔名
把重要畫面建成 kind screen 節點而非 service card 附件
用方向線連接操作、畫面跳轉與必要服務互動
在同一張畫布顯示 Before/After、完成 QA 並開啟 localhost Board
